Markets.title: US stocks: Crypto shares climb after Trump advocates for Clarity Act
Markets.summary: Cryptocurrency stocks rose after President Trump urged Congress to pass digital asset legislation, specifically advocating for the Clarity Act to clarify regulatory oversight. Major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ether also responded positively to the announcement.

Markets.title: smallcase Technologies expands under CASE Platforms; Zerodha CASE to be new name for mutual fund business
Markets.summary: Fintech firm smallcase Technologies has rebranded its corporate identity to CASE Platforms to unify its investment products and platform businesses. As part of this change, its mutual fund joint venture with Zerodha has been renamed Zerodha CASE Mutual Fund.

Markets.title: Walmart shares fall 8% as Q2 results flag risks of rising inventory
Markets.summary: Walmart shares fell 8% despite reporting strong second-quarter revenue and profit growth. Investors focused on a 6.7% increase in global inventory, which raised concerns about the company's underlying performance.

Markets.title: Oil rises to 3-week high as Iran war impasse fuels Middle East supply concerns
Markets.summary: Oil prices reached three-week highs, with Brent rising 2.39% to $93.81 and WTI gaining 2.89%. Both benchmarks headed for their fifth consecutive session of gains due to supply concerns stemming from the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz disruptions.

Markets.title: Tourism Finance Corporation among 6 financial services stocks to hit 52-week highs & surge up to 60% in a month
Markets.summary: Six stocks within the BSE Financial Services Index reached new 52-week highs during a 628-point surge in the Sensex. Tourism Finance led these gains with a 59% monthly increase, followed by Karnataka Bank and four other financial stocks.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market opens lower as bond yields climb
Markets.summary: US stocks opened lower on Thursday as rising government bond yields and a rare sales miss by Walmart dampened investor sentiment. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all experienced declines at the opening bell.

Geo-Political.title: At least 15 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
Geo-Political.summary: At least 15 people were killed in a massive Russian airstrike that targeted residential blocks and warehouses in Kyiv on Thursday. The attack highlighted Ukraine's ongoing struggle with severe air defense shortages.

Geo-Political.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
Geo-Political.summary: Following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire without a diplomatic resolution, Donald Trump has promised harsher economic measures against Iran and its supporters. This escalation occurs as the ongoing conflict lacks any clear military or diplomatic off-ramp.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande has been sentenced to life in prison. This sentencing marks a key moment in the fallout from the company's collapse, which severely shook China's property sector.

Geo-Political.title: Belgian car salesman becomes prince after royal parentage confirmed
Geo-Political.summary: Clément Vandenkerckhove, a Belgian car salesman, has officially become a prince following the confirmation of his royal parentage. He was quietly integrated into Prince Laurent's family during a town hall ceremony.

Geo-Political.title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
Geo-Political.summary: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian General Adel Issa to Syria to face war crimes charges. This marks the first time a former Assad regime officer has been handed over on such charges as Syria steps up its pursuit of wanted officials.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors are appealing Erin Patterson's prison sentence, arguing it is too lenient because it includes the possibility of parole. They stated she must stay in jail forever for her "truly dreadful" crimes.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sector growth slowed to 5.4% in July from a revised 6% in June. Iron ore, cement, and electricity were the primary drivers of this expansion.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. Whether the currency appreciates depends on if the inflows enter the market or are absorbed as reserves by the central bank.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated in the August MPC meeting minutes that the central bank requires clear evidence of persistent inflation before taking action. Consequently, the panel indicated potential future policy tightening if price levels remain elevated.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company shows how high-traffic corridors and the FASTag annual pass are shaping highway revenue. This data also highlights the changing role of private companies in funding and profiting from India's toll roads.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research raised India's GDP growth estimate for fiscal year 2027 to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia conflict, high inflation, currency depreciation, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The government is speeding up agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes from El Nino and a weak monsoon. This accelerated financial support aims to cushion rural consumption and offset climate-related risks to farming.

India.title: Specially Abled Man Pushed Off Mumbai Local, Dies. Accused Says "Chasing Crow"
India.summary: A specially abled man died after being pushed off a Mumbai local train between Mahim and Bandra stations on Thursday. The accused claimed he was trying to "chase a crow" when the incident occurred.

India.title: Classes In Cowshed, Little Girl Sweeping: Other Side Of Schooling In Rajasthan
India.summary: A Rajasthan education department survey found that 5,667 out of 63,018 state school buildings are dilapidated. Of these, 1,579 buildings have been formally declared unsafe for students.

India.title: XAT 2027 Mock Test On August 30: How To Apply, Check Eligibility
India.summary: The XAT 2027 mock test is scheduled for August 30 across more than 100 Indian test cities. More than 250 business schools accept the resulting XAT score for admissions.

India.title: Ex-Congress MP Sajjan Kumar, Convicted In 1984 Anti-Sikh Riots Case, Dies
India.summary: Former Congress MP Sajjan Kumar has died while serving a life sentence at Tihar jail for his role in the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. He was rushed to Safdarjung Hospital, where doctors declared him brought dead.

India.title: On Camera, 6-Year-Old Falls Face First, Dies After Being Slapped By Teacher
India.summary: A six-year-old child in India died after falling face-first following a slap by a teacher. The victim's family claims other children were also beaten and has demanded strict action.

India.title: "At 64, Top 10 In Class": Man Shares Father's MTech Success, Internet Amazed
India.summary: A 64-year-old working man graduated in the top 10 of his MTech class despite traveling for work. He now plans to pursue an Executive Education course at IIM Lucknow.

General.title: Five key takeaways from GCSE results day 2026
General.summary: On GCSE results day 2026, the number of student resits increased while the achievement gap between boys and girls decreased. Additionally, the regional performance divide across England widened.

General.summary: Travelodge boss Jo Boydell has resigned following criticism over the hotel chain's handling of safety and security issues. Her departure comes as the company works to improve security measures after a sexual assault occurred at one of its hotels.
